quotaWarningThresholds.title: Quota Warning Thresholds (%)
quotaWarningThresholds.description: Comma-separated percentages, e.g. "80,90", at which a user is emailed a quota warning. Each value must be a whole number between 1 and 99. A separate alert is sent when storage reaches 100%.

quotaGracePeriodDays.title: Quota Grace Period (days)
quotaGracePeriodDays.description: How many days a user may stay over their quota before smart deletion may act (only when smart deletion is enabled below). Minimum 0.

quotaSmartDeletionEnabled.title: Smart Deletion of Over-Quota Files
quotaSmartDeletionEnabled.description: Off by default. When enabled, after the grace period the oldest unsafe files of an over-quota user are deleted in a safe order: first unshared uploads, then files in shares inactive for the period below. Files in active shares are never deleted — if nothing is safe to remove, new uploads are simply blocked instead.

quotaInactiveShareDays.title: Inactive Share Threshold (days)
quotaInactiveShareDays.description: A share's files are eligible for smart deletion once the share has had no activity for this many days. Minimum 1.

reverseShareQuotaSoftEnforcement.title: Reverse Share Soft Enforcement
reverseShareQuotaSoftEnforcement.description: On by default. Lets external guests keep uploading to a reverse share even if the owner is slightly over quota, so collections are not interrupted. Uploads are still blocked once the owner exceeds the tolerance set below, and the owner is alerted to free up space.

reverseShareMaxOverageFactor.title: Reverse Share Overage Factor
reverseShareMaxOverageFactor.description: Soft enforcement allows reverse-share uploads until usage reaches this multiple of the owner's quota (e.g. 3 = up to three times the limit). Minimum 1.

reverseShareAbsoluteMaxBytes.title: Reverse Share Absolute Cap
reverseShareAbsoluteMaxBytes.description: Hard ceiling for reverse-share soft enforcement regardless of the factor above. Set to 0 for no absolute cap.

autoCleanupEnabled.title: Enable Automatic Cleanup
autoCleanupEnabled.description: Master switch for the scheduled cleanup of expired share links, expired reverse-share files, and orphans. Off by default — nothing is deleted automatically until you turn this on.

autoCleanupIntervalHours.title: Cleanup Interval (hours)
autoCleanupIntervalHours.description: How often the cleanup task runs. Minimum 1 hour.

autoCleanupGracePeriodDays.title: Grace Period (days)
autoCleanupGracePeriodDays.description: Extra days kept after a share or reverse share expires before it is permanently deleted. 0 means delete as soon as it expires.

autoCleanupNotifyDaysBefore.title: Warn Before Deletion (days)
autoCleanupNotifyDaysBefore.description: Send the owner a "pending permanent deletion" warning email this many days before the content is deleted. 0 disables the warning. Should be at most the grace period.

accountDeactivationCleanupEnabled.title: Delete Deactivated Accounts' Files
